business_scope.primary_industry_name: Real-Time Video Matching and Cross-Border Social Telephony

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Colombia (Unitary national jurisdiction; sub-state commercial registries operate as delegated registrars)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Romano-Germanic tradition; unitary national commercial legislation)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Colombia–United States Trade Promotion Agreement (TPA), in force 2012 (investment chapter)
Colombia–Canada Free Trade Agreement, in force 2011 (investment chapter)
Colombia–European Union Trade Agreement, provisionally applied since 2013
Colombia–China Bilateral Investment Treaty, in force 2012
Colombia–India Bilateral Investment Treaty, in force 2012
Colombia–Spain Reciprocal Promotion and Protection of Investments Agreement, in force 2008
Pacific Alliance trade agreement (Colombia, Peru, Chile, Mexico), in force from 2016 (framework protocol)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada) Articles 5, 9, 17-22, 25 and 45; Código de Comercio (Decreto 410 de 1971) Articles 110, 353-381 and 451; Decreto Único Reglamentario 1074 de 2015; Ley 1581 de 2012 for personal-data governance of the platform.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio with territorial jurisdiction at the S.A.S. registered office (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá) through the Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) and Registro Mercantil.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation instrument) inscribed in the Registro Mercantil; Escritura Pública and Registro de Instrumentos Públicos only when aportes comprise real property.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum subscribed or paid-up capital under Law 1258/2008, Article 9; quotas may be paid in cash, in-kind or in industry within a maximum term of two years; real-estate contributions require public deed. No state-mandated escrow account exists for S.A.S. capital; parties may optionally evidence payment by bank deposit in a Colombian financial institution.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION OF THE FIRST BOARD MEETING – S.A.S. 1. The incorporation document under Ley 1258 of 2008 is ratified; all subscribed shares are irrevocably taken up in accordance with the payment schedule in the bylaws. 2. The registered office is fixed at the address described in Article X of the bylaws, declared as principal place of business and tax domicile. 3. The following appointments are made: [Name] as Legal Representative, [Name] as Secretary, and [Name] as Data-Protection Compliance Officer, with statutory and by-law powers. 4. The Legal Representative is authorized to complete ancillary filings and open corporate bank accounts.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-incorporation name availability check (consulta de homonimia)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá (or territorial Chamber) through the RUES/CCB electronic window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the name-search request through the Chamber's virtual platform, entering up to three alternative S.A.S. names. The platform verifies name uniqueness and reserves the approved name for 30 days (extendable once). If the proposed name is approved, reserve the corresponding certificate and use it in the incorporation document.
required_dossiers: NIT or RUT of corporate founders, if any
Name-search application form digitally signed in RUES
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If homonimia is rejected, the applicant must file new alternatives and obtain a fresh certificate; an appeal may be sent to the Chamber's legal unit if the refusal is claimed to be unjustified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the private incorporation instrument (Documento Privado de Constitución)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública and Oficina de Registro de Instrumentos Públicos only for real-property aportes; otherwise executed as a private instrument by the shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the bylaws in Spanish including: corporate name, domicile, corporate purpose (ISIC 6311 digital services), subscribed capital with payment schedule, management structure, fiscal year, arbitral or judicial dispute rules, and dividend rules. All founders must sign with original signatures or certified digital signature. If real estate is contributed, elevate to public deed before a notary and register it with the ORIP.
required_dossiers: Valid IDs of all founders and, if a corporate founder, its certificate of incorporation and legal-representation proof
Power of attorney if a proxy signs for a founder
If real-property aporte: public deed, certificate of freedom and lien, and property tax (predial) certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Defects in the instrument are cured by an aclaratory protocol (documento aclaratorio) signed by the founders and filed with the Chamber prior to inscription; notarial defects are corrected by a notarial envelope.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration in the Registro Mercantil and issue of the Chamber certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio (e.g., CCB) via RUES
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the executed incorporation document and the standard registration forms (Formulario de Registro, pre-RUT, RUE declarations) through the RUES portal, and pay the registration fees (tariff 0.7% of subscribed capital, minimum approx. COP 36,000 ~ USD 11). The Chamber certifies the registrations, and the certificate of existence and legal representation ('certificado de existencia y representación legal') is generated.
required_dossiers: Documento Privado de Constitución in two signed copies
Identification of the filing representative with authorization from the legal representative
Payment receipt of the inscription fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber returns the filing for correction (devolución), remedy within five business days by updating the flagged clauses online and resubmitting; if the certificate presents data errors, apply for 'rectificación de datos' before the same Chamber.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax registration before DIAN (RUT and NIT)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) — electronic RUT service (Oficina Virtual)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Using an electronic signature through the DIAN website, complete the inscription in the Registro Único Tributario, obtaining the NIT. Assign the CIIU code 6311 as the primary activity (and 6399 as secondary, if applicable), select tax responsibilities (income tax, VAT, withholding), and define the invoicing and e-payment mechanisms for collections via Apple IAP and Paymentwall. Comply with additional zero-rating (IVA) and invoicing requirements as applicable to digital services.
required_dossiers: Certificado de existencia y representación legal (less than 30 days old)
CIIU economic-activity codes and declared address
Electronic signature and email already obtained for the company
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RUT is rejected due to inconsistent CIIU codes or address, file an 'actualización de RUT' with corrected information; if the NIT is suspended, complete the 'solicitud de habilitación' on the DIAN virtual portal.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN); electronic services portal: Muisca (muisca.dian.gov.co), https://www.dian.gov.co
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign shareholder incorporating an S.A.S. must (1) execute the private incorporation deed with a Colombian attorney-in-fact and register the company with the Cámara de Comercio; (2) apply for a provisional NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) through the DIAN RUT (Registro Único Tributario) module on Muisca; (3) appoint a local legal representative/fiscal domicile; (4) formalize the RUT (Formulario 022) online with the support of a certified public accountant (contador público) or lawyer to obtain the definitive 9-to-16 digit NIT. The S.A.S. is automatically classified in the Régimen Común for IVA purposes.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or pass-through election is available for an S.A.S.; it is a capital company taxed as a standalone taxpayer under the Estatuto Tributario (E.T.). Relevant statutory elections include: standard corporate income tax rate of 35%, foreign tax credit election under Art. 254 E.T., optional deferral of losses (Art. 147 E.T.), and voluntary 'gran contribuyente' status. Fiscal transparency (transparencia fiscal) is restricted to investment vehicles such as FIPs and FICs and cannot be elected by an S.A.S.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA (Impuesto sobre las Ventas / Value Added Tax)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No monetary threshold for legal entities: every S.A.S. carrying out taxable operations in Colombia must register in the RUT and remit IVA under the Régimen Común. The simplified regime (Régimen Simplificado) is reserved for natural persons with gross income below 3,500 UVT (approx. COP 165 million for tax year 2024) and is unavailable to the S.A.S.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing (Factura Electrónica de Venta, FEV) applies to all business taxpayers under Resolución DIAN 000165/2023. FEVs must be transmitted synchronously through DIAN's Muisca API or a DIAN-authorized software provider using the taxpayer's digital certificate and validated in near real time; each invoice must include the CUFE or CUDS unique tracking code. The video-match app's Apple IAP and Paymentwall revenue streams require FEV issuance for export services at 0%, with supporting electronic 'documento soporte' for acquisitions and advance invoicing (prepago) as applicable.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods exports qualify for the 0% export rate under Art. 481 E.T. with credit/recovery of input VAT. Services qualify under Art. 481(e) E.T. and Decree 1625/2016, Art. 1.3.1.13.2 when: (i) the service is rendered to a non-resident recipient without a permanent establishment in Colombia; (ii) the service is used exclusively abroad; and (iii) a written export-services contract (contrato de exportación de servicios) is executed and retained. The real-time video matching and cross-border telephony app supplied to foreign end users through Apple IAP or Paymentwall may qualify as an export of digital services, provided the users are non-resident and the service is not consumed in Colombia.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DEX / Declaración de Exportación)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill (B/L or AWB)
Commercial invoice and export-services contract (contrato de exportación de servicios)
Inward Remittance Certificate (Certificado de reintegro y declaración de cambio, Banco de la República, Form DCIP-188)
RUT evidencing exporter VAT status and, when required, fiscal residence certificate of the foreign recipient
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN rigorously audits export zero-rating and VAT refund claims. Failure to prove export status, to repatriate proceeds within 180 days, or to retain the complete documentary bundle triggers: (i) retroactive VAT assessment at 19% plus inflation adjustment and daily interest (Art. 634 E.T.); (ii) a penalty equal to 100% of the improperly claimed refund (Art. 648 E.T.); (iii) correction penalties up to 160% of the omitted tax on inaccurate returns (Art. 642 E.T.); and (iv) criminal tax-fraud liability under Law 1943/2018 where evasion exceeds COP 300 million, with possible imprisonment. Mischaracterizing Colombian users as foreign recipients for the video-match app exposes the entity to the 19% IVA on Colombian-sourced digital services plus fraud penalties.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (Central Bank of Colombia); the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia acts as the prudential regulator and foreign-exchange enforcement authority under Decree 1068 of 2015 and Banco de la República Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia operates a managed float with full current-account convertibility for bona fide trade and service operations, provided the transaction is executed through a licensed foreign-exchange intermediary and reported on a 'declaración de cambio'. Capital-account transactions are not prohibited but require prior registration with Banco de la República; inbound foreign investment into the Colombian S.A.S. must be registered in the national FDI registry before funds are repatriated. Profit remittances to non-resident shareholders are permissible after audited financial statements are filed and Colombian taxes are settled, but the local bank will require the FDI registration to remain active and will apply the statutory dividend withholding clearance. Late or missing registration is the main de facto convertibility barrier because the bank cannot process the onward remittance without it.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For goods exports, the exporter must channel 100 percent of export proceeds through a Colombian authorized foreign-exchange intermediary and must collect the proceeds within six months from the export date; an extension may be requested only on regulated grounds. There is no mandatory sale or conversion of export currency into pesos; proceeds may remain in a foreign-currency account in Colombia or in an authorized external account, but the full amount must be reported and evidenced by a bank settlement certificate. Services exports such as the app's subscription and IAP revenues are current-account service receipts and are not subject to forced surrender; however, when received through the banking system they must be filed on the applicable foreign-exchange declaration to support tax credits and central-bank statistics.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Rating: Low-Medium, with restricted utility. An offshore digital EMI such as Payoneer, Wise or Airwallex is not licensed by the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia as a payment company or SEDPE and cannot operate as the main treasury or custody account of the Colombian S.A.S. without triggering unregistered foreign-exchange activity. It may be used only as a supplemental collection or settlement rail for Apple IAP or Paymentwall if its license permits Colombian corporate onboarding; all settlement funds must nevertheless be forwarded to a Colombian Tier-1 bank, reported on the foreign-exchange declaration, and recorded in the company's statutory accounting and tax records. Using an offshore EMI as the sole account would create a legal blocker for corporate account maintenance, dividend distribution and audit sign-off.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In-person KYC interview is the market standard for Tier-1 banks at the first onboarding stage. The S.A.S. statutory representative, an appointed compliance officer, or an attorney-in-fact holding a notarized special power of attorney issued in Colombia must appear at the bank branch. Digital legalization and video onboarding are permitted only where the bank holds an SFC-approved virtual assisted onboarding mechanism, but for a non-resident-controlled medium-risk app, the bank will almost always require physical appearance or a Bogotá-based authorized representative. Originals or apostilled copies of the certificate of incorporation and existence, RUT, board resolution, UBO declaration, and original identity documents for all signatories are mandatory.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume micro-transactions from Apple IAP and Paymentwall without an identifiable final client registry
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Platform and KYC user-acquisition flow, app terms of service, data-flow diagram, Apple Developer Program Agreement, Paymentwall merchant service agreement, historical settlement reports, SFC-aligned corporate AML manual (SARLAFT), segregation of digital user wallets, and an institutional monitoring program to detect unusual transaction velocity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident multi-tier ownership and ultimate beneficial owners located in high-risk or crypto-friendly jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Chain-of-title ownership schedule, apostilled and translated certificates of incorporation of each intermediate holding company, government-issued identification and proof of address for every UBO, formal UBO declaration under Circular Básica Jurídica, source-of-wealth statement for the invested capital, and no-use-of-nominee declarations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Turnover forecast disproportionate to the low capital of an S.A.S. and lack of an audited track record
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Three-year audited or management projections, Paymentwall and Apple settlement statements proving recurring revenue, app download and retention metrics, details of the underlying software subscription or IP license, evidence that no paid-up minimum capital is due under Law 1258 of 2008, and a liquidity plan showing that all third-party liabilities are settled from operating revenue.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions and financial-crime exposure from anonymous random video matching or unrestricted geographic users
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Dynamic IP geoblocking and OFAC/UN/EU sanctions list screening of all payors and vendors, age-verification and facial or biometric match logs, moderation and trust-and-safety reports, UIAF/SAR filing protocol, contractual representation that Apple and Paymentwall perform their own sanctions compliance, and transactional monitoring against laundering patterns.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The foreign investor shall wire funds by SWIFT MT103 from its own account to the S.A.S.'s USD or COP account in the selected Tier-1 bank, with the bank instructed to apply the reference 'INVERSIÓN INTERNACIONAL / CÓDIGO DE CAMBIO' plus the Banco de la República FDI registration code. The bank will verify the originator against the registered foreign investor; if the originator or the declared purpose is different, the credit is frozen or reversed. A capital injection cannot be made through a third-party loan or an invoice for services; it must correspond to the subscribed shares in the S.A.S. and be supported by minutes of the shareholders' meeting approving the capital increase and by the updated company registry excerpt.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For operating outflows the S.A.S. will use local-origin SWIFT MT103 transfers for vendor fees, royalties and service charges, accompanied by the supplier or intercompany invoice, the service contract, tax withholding certificates and the foreign-exchange declaration ('declaración de cambio por pagos al exterior'). For physical goods or significant equipment procurement, an irrevocable commercial letter of credit, either at sight or deferred, may be issued by the Colombian bank, complemented by documentary collection or bank guarantees where appropriate. All outbound disbursements require the legal representative's signed instruction and the signatory matrix consistent with the board resolution; dividend payments additionally require the FDI registration, audited financials, tax clearance and proof of the shareholder meeting.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable COP/USD FX forwards with authorized Colombian foreign-exchange intermediaries, used only for hedging documented current or expected foreign-currency receipts.
Non-deliverable COP/USD forwards (NDFs) settled at the TRM when the S.A.S. has no deliverable USD account but needs to protect the peso value of future Apple IAP and Paymentwall remittances.

COP/USD currency swaps with the same authorized intermediaries, permitted for balance-sheet and liquidity hedging in amounts associated with committed cross-border receivables and debt-service obligations.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Renewal of Commercial Registration (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local Cámara de Comercio (Chamber of Commerce)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before March 31 of each calendar year, effective for the current fiscal period
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal triggers a fine of up to 17 UVT (approx. USD 450 for 2025) plus surcharges; failure to renew for two consecutive years results in administrative strike-off from the commercial registry and loss of legal capacity to operate.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Depositary of Financial Statements (Estados Financieros)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local Cámara de Comercio (Chamber of Commerce)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By May 31 of the year following the fiscal year-end (for December 31 year-end); the shareholders' meeting must approve the statements before this date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to deposit can trigger fines of up to 17 UVT, restriction on issuing legal certificates, and a prohibition on registering new directors or officers until compliance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Final Beneficiaries Annual Report (Reporte de Beneficiarios Finales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) and Superintendencia de Sociedades
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual filing window, generally ending on July 31 of each year as stipulated in the current DIAN resolution
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing or inaccurate filing carries penalties up to 6,250 UVT (approx. USD 165,000) per violation; repeated failure can trigger debarment from public contracts and tax represents.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory statutory audit and revisor fiscal appointment required if total assets exceed 5,000 SMMLV (approx. COP 17.5 billion) or gross revenue exceeds 3,000 SMMLV (approx. COP 10.5 billion), or if the entity is subject to oversight by the Superintendencia de Sociedades; for S.A.S. not meeting these thresholds, audit is optional unless mandated by statutes or shareholders.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Colombian Financial Reporting Standards (NIIF/IFRS as issued by CTCP under Law 1314/2009); medium/small entities apply Chapter 2 (IFRS for SMEs) unless size thresholds for full IFRS are exceeded.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annually, each company must file the Reporte de Beneficiarios Finales with DIAN and the Superintendencia before the July deadline. The report must identify every individual holding more than 5% of shares, controlling votes, or benefiting through control. Shareholder and director updates must also be filed with the Chamber of Commerce during the annual renewal window.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Minute Book

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 300 - USD 1,200 per year for registered office and local agent services in Bogotá or Medellín
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500 - USD 12,000 for a typical mid-size digital services S.A.S. depending on revenue complexity
